## What's new

- Set a cover from your phone: in ChaOS Transfer, open a console's folder and press Cover beside a game. Choose a picture to send a photo or a saved image, or Use a link to have the Brick fetch one over Wi-Fi: a picture's address, an itch.io game's page (its cover is used) or a Google Images result.
- Favorites say so: pressing Y on a game shows "Added to Favorites" or "Removed from Favorites", and a game's X menu says how.
- ChaOS-diatom 0.9.6.

---

ChaOS 1.3.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v1.3.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v1.3.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
